function: above_phy (p. 3): the only learned part is a DQN for IoV-BS user association (selecting two IoVs for NOMA); power allocation and BD-RIS phase shifts are solved by classical optimization.
notes: Reason above_phy, p. 3: "the problem of IoV association with BS is solved using deep reinforcement learning (DRL), where a deep Q-network (DQN) algorithm is adopted"; p. 6: the DQN action "is the selection of two IoVs (i.e., IoV i and IoV j) from the set of M IoVs". The physical-layer decisions are not learned, p. 3: "we compute the power allocation at BS using the first-order Taylor expansion and Dinkelbach methods" and "we solve the BD-RIS phase shift designing problem using the manifold optimization method". User association/scheduling in a terrestrial V2I downlink is above the physical layer; the DQN does not learn power or phases jointly (they are outside its action space, p. 6), so the joint exception does not apply, and the link is not satellite or aerial. Not no_learning, because the DQN is part of the proposed method rather than motivation or baseline. Context: single-antenna BS and IoVs with a fully-connected reflective BD-RIS (p. 4), custom Rayleigh/Rician channels (pp. 4-5), and results compare only BD-RIS against conventional RIS (pp. 8-10). Title and DOI 10.1109/JIOT.2025.3569811 confirmed on page 1.
